sourceChecks.text: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Maacah
wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事は複数の同名者を区別し、ダビデの妻でタルマイの娘とされるマアカを挙げます。
wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: Article lines 114–125 distinguishes several Maacahs; line 118 identifies the David figure as wife of David and daughter of Talmai king of Geshur. It also says she bore Tamar, omitted from the first-use note because that is learned later in Samuel.

notesJa: 固定WEB節本文と前後文脈を確認。用例ID、表記、初出時点を記録。
